RagShortTexts: Fri-khwataw complained from Guzang that he was isolated and no caravan was leaving.

Variants.Content: Fri-khwataw complained from Guzang that he was isolated and no caravan was leaving. He had followed a partner to Dunhuang but returned after movement failed. Travel depended on companions, a passable route and reception at the next stage; both person and stock could be stranded.
